u0: The episode has just begun or the ball is still in front of the door while the key may or may not be carried; no obligation is currently outstanding. Either the ball stays in the way or it is moved clear, and if it is moved while the key is not yet in hand the agent takes on a debt to acquire the key at some point. To finish cleanly, eventually pick up the matching key and open the door to reach the target box.
u1: The key is in hand, or the ball is out of the way and the key is also held, so the requirement tying moving the ball to obtaining the key is satisfied. No obligation remains from that rule and there is nothing to compensate for. The remaining objective is the mission itself: open the door with the key and pick up the designated box.
u2: The ball has been moved away from the door while the matching key is not currently carried, so the agent owes acquiring that key at some later point. The task is not yet failed, but the requirement is broken for good if the episode ends without the key being taken. Picking up the matching key would discharge the debt and return the situation to an unencumbered state.
